# A whole Style held in state, rendered by a real browser.
#
# html wrote a style that was not a literal as setAttribute("style", <object>)
# in the handlers, which the browser reads as "[object Object]", and wrote
# nothing on first render. testdata/style_value_state.txtar shows the CSS text
# the page now builds; this runs it, on first render, after the whole value is
# replaced and after one field of it is written, and reads the style back off
# the DOM as Chromium parsed it.
#
# Confirmed by reverting the html change: no snapshot carries a color or a
# font-size.

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'

grep 'color: rgb\(255, 0, 0\)' app.sngl.snapshots/before.html
grep 'font-size: 14px' app.sngl.snapshots/before.html
! grep 'style="[^"]*font-weight' app.sngl.snapshots/before.html

grep 'color: rgb\(0, 0, 255\)' app.sngl.snapshots/swapped.html
grep 'font-size: 20px' app.sngl.snapshots/swapped.html
grep 'font-weight: bold' app.sngl.snapshots/swapped.html
grep 'border-style: dashed' app.sngl.snapshots/swapped.html

grep 'color: rgb\(0, 255, 0\)' app.sngl.snapshots/tinted.html
grep 'font-size: 20px' app.sngl.snapshots/tinted.html

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import . "sngl:ui"

output { none { html } }

component main node {
    var s Style = {color=#ff0000, fontSize=14px}

    button #swap(text="swap", @click {
        s = {color=#0000ff, fontSize=20px, fontWeight=bold, borderWidth=2px, borderStyle=dashed}
    })
    button #tint(text="tint", @click { s.color = #00ff00 })
    text(value="styled", style=s)
}

func testStyleValueFollowsState(t Test, c main) {
    t.snapshot("before")
    c.swap.click()
    t.snapshot("swapped")
    c.tint.click()
    t.snapshot("tinted")
}

window {
    main
}
-- testrun/html/none/app.sngl/main/1 --
